# Embedded font assets

The generated Force Curve Bench embeds these Latin WOFF2 subsets so the
single-file viewer has no runtime font request and renders consistently when
opened offline.

| File | Upstream family | Weight | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| `inter-latin.woff2` | Inter | variable 400–800 | `3100e775e8616cd2611beecfa23a4263d7037586789b43f035236a2e6fbd4c62` |
| `ibm-plex-mono-500-latin.woff2` | IBM Plex Mono | 500 | `01d285447409c8a588692162439a038b8cbd7871309ee20267b0d2d91c6e8e22` |
| `ibm-plex-mono-600-latin.woff2` | IBM Plex Mono | 600 | `0d1f0b8d0722224e32e9f28261bdc86c79115be73444ae5eceb73976a1bcdf83` |

The font files are redistributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The
complete upstream notices are included as `INTER-LICENSE.txt` and
`IBM-PLEX-LICENSE.txt`. These font licenses apply only to their respective font
software and do not change the Force Curve Bench project's own rights notice.
